newsitem.title: UK: No sign of much rain in Europe after weekend - WSC.
newsitem.headline: No sign of much rain in Europe after weekend - WSC.

text.p: Light to moderate rain now developing over parched areas of England and France should increase into the weekend, but beyond that the weather could turn drier and warmer, independent U.S. forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Friday.

After this current weather system, there was "No sign of an additional significant (rainfall) event" in the period up to the following weekend, and the weather could even turn much warmer, WSC forecaster Joel Burgio told Reuters by telephone from Lexington, Mass.
During the coming 24 hours to around midday on Saturday, "You're looking at for England light rain in the order of one-tenth to three-tenths of an inch or so," Burgio said.
"For France some of the northeast portion of the country could get some, but the rest only a few sprinkles and light showers."
From Saturday into Sunday, though, "There will be an increasing chance of showers and rain to cover much of the region," particularly France.
England would see additional light showers but there could be one-quarter to three-quarters of an inch of rain in France, with perhaps locally heavier falls.

WSC's latest three-to-five day forecast said the British Isles had a chance of light to moderate showers on Sunday, a few lingering showers on Monday, then fair weather on Tuesday. Temperatures would be near to above normal.

Elsewhere in western Europe, showers would continue in the east and south on Sunday, with showers and light rain in the east on Monday. It would be fair elsewhere, with a few light showers in the far north.
Temperatures were forecast to trend milder in the north, but would continue below normal in the south.
Germany and Central Europe would be cool and unsettled on Sunday and Monday, with some improvement on Tuesday, WSC said.

In Mediterranean Europe, showers were expected to progress from western areas into the central Mediterranean over the coming three to five days, with a few showers possible in the east by the end of the period and temperatures mostly below normal.
